sources.name: Maine Revenue Services 2026 Withholding Tables (revised August 2026)

notes: Read from the official 2026 publication listed in sources on 2026-10-20. Not yet signed off.

Percentage method steps 1-6: annualize; $5,300 per W-4ME allowance; standard deduction for withholding $12,850 single or $28,550 married, phased out linearly between $102,250 and $177,250 (single) or $204,550 and $354,550 (married); rate schedule; divide and round to the dollar.
Head of household uses the single schedule and deduction (the booklet gives only single and married).
Official examples 1-3 (weekly $300 single = $0, $1,000 single = $32, $4,500 married = $256) are asserted in tests. The August 2026 booklet's income tax surcharge note is not modelled.
